prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady forward movement along a rugged, rocky path in Shengshan Island, Zhoushan, China, under a cloudy, foggy night sky. The camera smoothly glides over uneven terrain, capturing the intricate textures of moss-covered stones and scattered foliage that line the trail. As the journey progresses, the path transitions from rocky patches to a more defined dirt trail, bordered by dense vegetation and slender trees that stand tall against the dimly lit backdrop. The camera angle remains consistent, offering a clear view of the path ahead while subtly panning to reveal the surrounding natural environment. The muted lighting casts soft shadows, enhancing the earthy tones of the trail and the dark silhouettes of the trees. The atmosphere is serene and isolated, with no signs of human presence, emphasizing the quiet solitude of the nocturnal setting. The camera continues its steady advance, navigating through the narrow, winding path, occasionally adjusting to maintain focus on the trail as it curves gently through the forested landscape. The overall ambiance is one of peaceful exploration, with the natural elements of the island providing a rich, immersive experience.
